checks.title: Confirm lifecycle question and owner
checks.instructions: Name the product, tenant, signup population, decision owner, 30-day retention question and excluded accounts. Agree that cohort averages do not create individual churn labels.

checks.title: Freeze cohort and event policy
checks.instructions: Record signup windows, eligible account definition, activation predicate and day-30 retention predicate with versions, identity join, deduplication, timezone and internal/test exclusions.

checks.title: Set maturity and censoring rule
checks.instructions: Compute the last signup date plus 30 days for each cohort. A not-yet-mature cohort is pending_maturity with null retained count and no trend. One mature cohort is baseline_first; compare two only when duration, rule and source coverage match.

checks.title: Verify identity and source coverage
checks.instructions: Probe authorized signup and product event records and active subscription state for the same account/tenant. Record source revisions, matched/unmatched accounts, billing lag, observation cutoff and minimum coverage.

checks.title: Bind two distinct Crews
checks.instructions: Inspect and reuse or create Lifecycle Analyst and Growth Experiment Planner Crew IDs with selected skills and distinct output paths. Do not use an account-specific first-value readout as a cohort denominator.

checks.title: Test both source and handoff reads
checks.instructions: Have Lifecycle Analyst read a representative authorized event and subscription record. Have Growth Experiment Planner read the validated mature observation and experiment policy. Save exact source, account scope, timestamps and missing access.

checks.title: Validate maturity-aware artifacts
checks.instructions: Save cohort-retention-observation/v1, run the blocking validator and verify an immature cohort stops planning. For one mature case, pass the exact artifact ID to Growth Experiment Planner, save retention-experiment-plan/v1 and validate both. Record paths, Crew run IDs and rejected false-churn case.

checks.title: Review Builder proposal
checks.instructions: Show Crew reuse/creation, cohort/source coverage, maturity threshold, validator, owner, change authority, metric, guardrail and sample policy. Selection authorizes no query, customer contact or experiment launch.

checks.title: Run one bounded cohort case
checks.instructions: Use authorized records for one mature or still-immature cohort and, when available, a comparable second mature cohort. Recompute counts/rates, review limitations with the owner and keep the route manual if source truth or validator is missing.

checks.title: Choose repeat policy
checks.instructions: Record manual-only or a reviewed paused schedule with timezone, cohort maturity wait, source freshness, billing lag, query cost, retries and notifications. Completing setup does not enable recurrence or customer actions.
